notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Kami of Whispered Hopes do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 3 or greater.
description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.
